styles.container: width: 440px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 20px; font-family: "PingFang SC", -apple-system, "system-ui", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Segoe UI", "Microsoft YaHei", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 28px !important; color: #24292e !important; background-color: #ff4e79 !important; word-wrap: break-word; display: block; position: relative; overflow: visible;
styles.h1: font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; color: #24292e !important; line-height: 30px !important; margin: 16px 0 0; padding: 0;
styles.h2: font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; color: #24292e !important; line-height: 25px !important; margin: 16px 0 0; padding: 0;
styles.h3: font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; color: #24292e !important; line-height: 25px !important; margin: 16px 0 0; padding: 0;
styles.h4: font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: #24292e !important; line-height: 1.4 !important; margin: 16px 0 0; padding: 0;
styles.h5: font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; color: #24292e !important; line-height: 1.4 !important; margin: 16px 0 0; padding: 0;
styles.h6: font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #24292e !important; line-height: 1.4 !important; margin: 16px 0 0; padding: 0;
styles.ol: margin: 16px 0; padding: 15px; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7) !important; border: 1px dashed #a6a6a6; border-radius: 8px;
styles.blockquote: margin: 16px 0 0; padding: 10px 20px; background-color: transparent !important; border-left: none; color: #24292e !important; line-height: 28px !important; font-style: italic;
styles.code: font-family: SFMono-Regular, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", Menlo, monospace; font-size: 14.4px; padding: 2px 5px; background-color: #eaecf1 !important; color: #24292e !important; border-radius: 4px; line-height: 25.2px;
styles.pre: margin: 20px 0; padding: 16px; background-color: #2d2d2d !important; border-radius: 8px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6 !important;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; max-height: 600px !important; height: auto; display: block; margin: 20px auto; border-radius: 8px;
styles.th: background-color: #f0f0f0 !important; padding: 10px; text-align: left; border: 1px solid #e0e0e0; font-weight: 600;
